items.prompt: Character turnaround sheet of ONE original character in the same clean Japanese anime / Korean webtoon style as the reference image (realistic human proportions, crisp black outlines, soft cel shading, natural colors). Exactly four full-body views of the same person standing side by side from left to right: front view, left side view, right side view, back view. Head to shoes fully visible, same outfit and hairstyle in every view, plain pure white background, no text, no labels, no props on the floor, evenly spaced. A 70-year-old Korean man, a kind elderly hotel guest who is secretly a business chairman: short, white neat hair, white eyebrows, gentle smile, round silver glasses, a long-sleeved plain beige knit cardigan (long sleeves down to the wrists in every view, including the back view) over a white shirt, gray trousers, brown walking shoes, holding a wooden cane in his right hand in every view.
